However, his plan goes awry and the rabbit problem escalates when the villagers discover a monstrous `were-rabbit' destroying everything in its sights. Will Wallace and Gromit be able to solve the conundrum before the creature gets shot. - 2005

bbc3.uk.title: Mrs Brown's Boys - Christmas Special Mammy's A.
bbc3.uk.description: All over Dublin, mothers are excitedly looking forward to seeing their loved ones return home for Christmas, but Agnes Brown is depressed. Her son Trevor is on the missions in Canada, and can't possibly afford to make it back. With Maria's posh mum Hillary pressing the newlyweds to spend Christmas at her place, Agnes decides to compete for their love by providing an even more lavish Christmas celebration than Hillary's. (Entertainment, Holiday, Sitcom) - 2011

bbc3.uk.title: Mrs Brown's Boys - Christmas Special: Buckin' Mammy
bbc3.uk.description: Christmas is just round the corner, and no-one knows what Bono wants for a present. He's already posted his letter off to Santa, so how can Mrs Brown find out in time? Meanwhile, at her family games night, Agnes struggles to control her temper when none of the guests will play by her rules. At least there shouldn't be any problems with the Christmas tree - she's having a very special one delivered. (Entertainment, Holiday, Sitcom) - 2013

bbc3.uk.title: Office Christmas Party (2016)

bbc3.uk.title: Things You Should Have Done - Learn to Drive
bbc3.uk.description: Stay-at-home-daughter Chi is suddenly forced to fend for herself when her parents die in a car crash. Chi learns she will only inherit the house on condition she completes a list of 'Things You Should Have Done' left in the parents' will, the first of which is, ironically, learn to drive. Meanwhile, Chi's highly strung auntie Karen wants nothing to do with her dependent pest of a niece, but very much wants the house she feels is rightfully hers. (Comedy, Sitcom) - 2024

bbc3.uk.title: Things You Should Have Done - Get a Job
bbc3.uk.description: Chi spectacularly fails a trial period at the pharmacy with Karen, but Dave kindly lets her shadow him on his delivery rounds. On a drop-off to a retirement home Chi finds her tribe... old people. She also falls in love with Linda, an elderly lady who seems to think Chi is her husband. Elsewhere, Dave has a health scare, and Karen starts to think she might be the fertility issue. (Comedy, Sitcom) - 2024

bbc3.uk.title: Things You Should Have Done - Learn to Cook
bbc3.uk.description: Pancake day is a highly sentimental time for Chi. When Dave confides in Lucas about his health scare, they vow to make the most of every moment, and that begins with pancake day. (Sitcom) - 2024

bbc3.uk.title: Things You Should Have Done - Pay Your Bills
bbc3.uk.description: There's a shock for Chi when she discovers that bills are a thing and her electricity and water get cancelled. As a result, she decides she's just going to live with Auntie Karen instead. (Sitcom) - 2024

bbconemidlands.uk.description: S19 E3 It's the first quarter-final, and the four chefs who have fought their way through the heats return to the kitchen with everything to play for. First up, the chefs face the invention test in which they must make a dish starring a surprise ingredient - coconut. The cooks must then serve a two-course meal for two of the country's most discerning food critics, William Sitwell and Xanthe Clay, alongside chef and writer Rahel Stephanie.

Featuring Katie Piper, Shaun Williamson, Josie d'Arby, Jean Johansson and Claire Sweeney.

Plus, the case of an extremist in Newport recruiting for so-called Islamic State.

bbconemidlands.uk.description: S75 E12 Taunton 12 Friends Aimi and Neil on the red team and siblings Joe and Bella in blue scour an antiques centre in Taunton, Somerset for bargains to sell for profit under the guidance of Ben Cooper and Danny Sebastian. Christina Trevanion visits the historic town of Malmesbury in neighbouring Wiltshire.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Northumbria Mysteries
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E3 A healthy young labourer is found dead in a shallow ornamental pond on the vast country estate of Lady Philippa Armstrong and her son Jonathan. While the tragic incident initially appears to be nothing more than a straightforward workplace accident, Rose and Raj are called in to investigate glaring discrepancies.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Escape to the Country
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S22 E8 Shropshire Nicki Chapman helps a first-time buyer from Birmingham to find a home in the Shropshire countryside, and helps out by pulling pints for the locals at a community-owned pub.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Bidding Room
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S7 E9 Bust of Apollo, Antique Handcuffs, Mannequin Head Carl from Hull is the first visitor to Edinburgh's Leith Theatre, selling some antique handcuffs from his personal collection. A concrete bust of Apollo, a designer lampshade, a vintage camera and two mannequin heads are also among the items on offer. Presented by Nigel Havers.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Bridge of Lies
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S4 E20 Quiz show hosted by Ross Kemp in which contestants compete for cash by crossing a bridge made up of stepping stones, each of which has a different option. Friends Paula, Ranie, Aaron and Pam must try to get from A to B by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies in order to cross the studio floor safely, or risk falling off the bridge and out of the game.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Pointless
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S30 E44 Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Sally Phillips.

bbconemidlands.uk.description: 06/11/2026 The latest headlines.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The One Show
bbconemidlands.uk.description: 06/11/2026 Topical magazine-style programme that showcases stories of all varieties from all over the UK, ranging from the comic to the tragic, as well as interviews with guest stars.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Return to Paradise
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S3 E1 Stilled Life Resident wedding ruiner Mackenzie Clarke is paying the price for Glenn's absence. With Phil offside and a disastrous first impression made with new pathologist Leo, she's not winning any popularity contests in Dolphin Cove. So when an artist dies on stage in front of an audience during an avant-garde performance piece for the local art fair, Mackenzie is dismayed to find that their main suspect, the victim's muse, has a surprising and complicated connection to her. Murder mystery, starring Anna Samson.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Return to Paradise
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S3 E2 Built to Kill Solitary Mackenzie Clarke reckons with the arrival of her uninhibited house guest. When a happy-go-lucky builder dies after falling from the roof of a construction site, she is immediately on the case. Mack knows a bodged-up job when she sees it. This was no accident, this was murder. The further Mack digs, the more she uncovers: a history of debt blackmail, illicit trysts and buried secrets.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Have I Got News for You
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S72 E6 Steph McGovern hosts as guest panellist journalist Helen Lewis joins team captains Ian Hislop and Paul Merton for a satirical look at the news of the week.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: BBC News at Ten
bbconemidlands.uk.description: 06/11/2026 A round-up of today's headlines.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Graham Norton Show
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S34 E7 Together on Graham's sofa are Oscar-winner Judi Dench, discussing her memoir Is It Too Late to Make a Run for It?, actor Alan Cumming, returning to the UK stage in My Fair Lady, Tramell Tillman, who stars in the new Christmas Carol adaptation Ebenezer, and Derry Girls and Bridgerton star Nicola Coughlan, in powerful new drama I Am Helen. With music by James Blunt, performing his current single Circles.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: RuPaul's Drag Race UK
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S8 E10 It's the grand finale, and the time has come for the competition to conclude as the queens compete in their final challenge - an all-singing, all-dancing extravaganza to fight for the crown. Choreographer Claudimar Neto coaches the queens as they perform a megamix of Drag Race UK's most iconic girl group songs. Michelle Visage, Alan Carr and Graham Norton form the judging panel, while last year's winner and reigning champion Bones drops by along with this season's eliminated queens.

stvnorth.uk.title: Emmerdale
stvnorth.uk.description: E10692 05/11/2026 Cain urges Kammy to stay quiet. Nicola opens up to Kev, while Caleb begins to panic.

stvnorth.uk.title: Coronation Street
stvnorth.uk.description: E11977 05/11/2026 Kit's outburst at work triggers calls for him to take sick leave, Idris looks forward to seizing control of the factory, Gemma hears from the hospital, and Debbie invites the girls over.

stvnorth.uk.title: Dear Henry: Our Fight for Justice - A Tonight Special
stvnorth.uk.description: S28 E8 The 2025 murder of 18-year-old Henry Nowak shocked millions after footage of his final moments came to light at the trial of his attacker in June this year. In an interview with Paul Brand, Henry's family share memories of a much-loved son and brother, while asking questions about the treatment he received, and the police investigation that followed.

stvnorth.uk.description: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Sophie Marceau and Robert Carlyle. After the death of oil magnate Sir Robert King in a booby trap, agent James Bond becomes bodyguard to King's daughter, Elektra, to protect her from her father's killer.

stvnorth.uk.title: Lingo

Taking part alongside the reigning champions are father and son Gerry and Grant, and Julie and her niece Emma. Adil Ray hosts.

stvnorth.uk.title: Nations Championship : Ireland v Argentina
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E19 Ireland v Argentina (Kick-off 8.10pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from the opening match in the Northern Hemisphere leg of the tournament, held at Aviva Stadium. After wins over Australia and Japan and a loss to New Zealand in July, Andy Farrell's Ireland will be aiming to start their autumn campaign on the front foot against the Pumas, who lost to Scotland and England either side of a victory over Wales in the Southern Series. With analysis from Maggie Alphonsi and Bryan Habana, pitchside inserts with Brian O'Driscoll and Claire Thomas, and commentary by Nick Mullins and Gordon D'Arcy.

talkingpictures.uk.description: A television adaptation of some of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's popular stories. (Mystery) - 1955

talkingpictures.uk.title: Doublecross (1956)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A Cornish fisherman, Albert Pascoe, is paid by two men and a woman to take them over to France by trawler, unaware that they have stolen top secret documents. (Drama) - 1956

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Secret Six (1931)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Reporters, vigilantes, a moll and a crooked lawyer bring down a bootlegger. (Crime drama) - 1931

talkingpictures.uk.description: A stuntman is framed for murder by an undercover organisation that sells counterfeit passports to unfortunate refugees. (Crime drama) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: Appointment With Venus (1952)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Four Star Playhouse - The Stacked Deck
talkingpictures.uk.description: Fresh out of prison, blackmailer Gus Anderson intends to use Willie's casino to launder his victims' money. To insure his cooperation, Gus' thugs hold one of Willie's waiters hostage. (Drama, Anthology) - 1956

talkingpictures.uk.title: Spotlight on the Stars: Margaret Lockwood
talkingpictures.uk.description: Let's turn back the spotlight with Margaret Lockwood as she presents some of the pictures and personalities who are up to be voted for in the 1948 National Film Awards.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Duchess of Duke Street - No Lawyers, No Letters
talkingpictures.uk.description: Louisa learns that her landlords would like to terminate her lease and are looking for a breach of it on her part. (Historical drama, Romance) - 1976

talkingpictures.uk.title: Whistle Down the Wind (1962)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A murderer on the run takes refuge in a barn on a lonely Lancashire farm and inadvertently leads the farmer's three children to believe that he is Jesus Christ. (Drama) - 1962

talkingpictures.uk.title: Look at Life - Turning Blades
talkingpictures.uk.description: A look at the importance of the helicopter and its uses, both civil and military but also its failure to become a passenger carrier. (Documentary, Community, History) - 1962

talkingpictures.uk.title: Julius Hagen Season - Week 9: Julius Hagen Outro: A Fire Has Been Arranged
talkingpictures.uk.description: Tune in to find out which brilliant Julius Hagen film will be shown next week.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Weir's Way - Glen Affric
talkingpictures.uk.description: Equipped with walking boots and bobbly hat, Tom explores the delights of Glen Affric. (Entertainment, Travel) - 2014

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Brothers - The Race
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Race. 1974. Stars Jennifer Wilson, Richard Easton, John Rolfe. The board is divided about sponsorship of David's race. Meanwhile, Martin questions Brian about Jennifer's relationship with Ted. (Drama) - 1974

talkingpictures.uk.title: Saber of London - Fast Cars and Girls
talkingpictures.uk.description: One-armed detective Mark Saber, an Englishman working with the New York Police Department, along with his assistant, Sergeant Tim Moloney, tracks down criminals by his brilliant use of deduction as well as regular police methods. (Drama, Crime)

talkingpictures.uk.description: Tony Christie sings 'Amarillo' and 'Old Man River'. Francis Yip sings 'Make My Life a Bit Brighter'. Terri Rogers, Alan Randall and Eddie Flanagan also star. (Comedy, Music) - 1975

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Undertaker (2023)
talkingpictures.uk.description: An undertaker makes the wrong choice at a moral crossroads as he is made to dispose of the victims of a gangster's power grab. (Thriller) - 2023

talkingpictures.uk.title: Bad Blood (1982)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Set in WW2 and based on a true story of the New Zealand farmer who refuses to hand in his firearms and the siege that follows. (Drama documentary / Drama / Thriller) - 1982

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Disappearance of Flight 412 (1974)
talkingpictures.uk.description: An Air Force colonel finds the government is strangely quiet about the vanishing of two jets on the trail of a UFO. (Drama) - 1974

talkingpictures.uk.title: What's on TPTV with Noel
talkingpictures.uk.description: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout November. (Entertainment, History, Talk) - 2026

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sergeant Cork - The Case of the Girl Upstairs
talkingpictures.uk.description: Cork and Marriott investigate the case of a terrified woman who is under the supervision of a sadistic doctor. (Drama, Crime) - 1963

talkingpictures.uk.title: Burke's Law - Who Killed Mother Goose
talkingpictures.uk.description: The famous children's author known as Mother Goose is found strangled with her own typewriter ribbon. (Drama, Suspense) - 1965

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - Batman Makes the Scenes
talkingpictures.uk.description: Believing the dynamic duo has been finished off, the podgy purveyor of perfidy and his finks quickly dash to establish their `alibis'. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Crime) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Cinebox Memories
talkingpictures.uk.description: Pop singer Wayne Gibson performs the phenomenal hit I Like It. (Documentary) - 2025

talkingpictures.uk.title: Algiers (1938)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A wealthy young woman falls prey to the dazzle of the Casbah and the charm of its most notorious denizen, Pepe Le Moko. (Crime drama) - 1938

talkingpictures.uk.title: Mark of the Phoenix (1957)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Crooks steal a secret metal formula and plan to smuggle it into East Germany. (Thriller) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: Railway Murders - The Police Killer
talkingpictures.uk.description: Investigating the most notorious murders ever to take place on the British railways. Nicholas Day narrates the history of blood on the tracks of Britain.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Make Me an Offer (1955)
talkingpictures.uk.description: The story of Charlie, who as a boy fell in love with a Portland Vase on a trip to a museum, pursues his dream as an antiques dealer. (Comedy) - 1955

talkingpictures.uk.title: Tell Me Another - More Stories about Their Careers
talkingpictures.uk.description: Dick Hills tells personal anecdotes. (Entertainment, Interview) - 1978

talkingpictures.uk.title: Dusty Ermine (1936)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Going `straight' after being in jail, Jim is suspected when forged notes start circulating in the area. (Crime drama / Drama) - 1936

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood - Tables Turned
talkingpictures.uk.description: Robin is accused of kidnapping two children he finds in the forest. (Action, Adventure) - 1956

talkingpictures.uk.title: My Brother's Keeper (1949)

talkingpictures.uk.description: The story of how John Hunter became to work for Eastern Insurance is suspicious. Will Hunter have to prove his innocence. (Drama, Mystery) - 1962

talkingpictures.uk.title: A Family At War - Into the Dark

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Young Mr. Pitt (1942)
talkingpictures.uk.description: This biopic tells the story of the 24-year-old British Prime Minister who served during the Napoleonic era. (Drama) - 1942

talkingpictures.uk.title: Public Eye - Nobody Wants to Know
talkingpictures.uk.description: Marker has one week in which to find a witness. When he does so, he'll never forget her. (Drama, Mystery, Crime) - 1975

talkingpictures.uk.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro - Part One: The Four Sided Triangle
talkingpictures.uk.description: Caroline Munro takes a look at one of the first sci-fi ventures by Hammer productions. Written and directed by Terence Fisher, starring James Hayter and Barbara Payton - The Four Sided Triangle. (Horror, Science fiction) - 2021

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Four Sided Triangle (1953)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A young man, stuck in a love triangle with his former best friend and a woman who can never be his, discovers a way to fulfil his dreams when he discovers a way to duplicate the woman. (Science fiction) - 1953

talkingpictures.uk.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro - Outro Week 172
talkingpictures.uk.description: Caroline Munro has a look at the special film to be shown next week down in The Cellar Club. (Horror, Science fiction) - 2026

talkingpictures.uk.title: Tomorrow (1972)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Based on a story by William Faulkner. A lonely handyman takes a protective interest in an abandoned pregnant woman. (Drama) - 1972

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Most Dangerous Game (1932)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A psychopathic hunter goes after the most dangerous game of all on a desolate island. He wants to hunt and kill humans for sport. His intended victims are the survivors of a shipwreck, which the hunter arranged specifically for the occasion. (Horror) - 1932

together.uk.title: Clive Myrie's Italian Roadtrip - Lazio
together.uk.description: Clive heads north from Lazio's capital, Rome, to the dramatic valleys of Italy's badlands, out of which rise the fairy-tale citadel of Civita di Bagnoregio - Lazio's ghost town. Meeting one of the 20 remaining residents, Clive finds out what it's like to be outnumbered by a million annual visitors, and he explores the ancient tunnels beneath the town to discover why it's slowly crumbling to dust.

bloomberg.us.title: Insight With Haslinda Amin ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day. With news making executives, officials and thought-leaders from the world of business, politics and academia we will explore a story through probing interviews and nuanced conversations. The hour of programming will also highlight the most relevant stories from India which is currently one of the hottest investment destinations, but also has compelling stories that play into the Bloomberg's priority issues such as Climate change, Diversity and Technological innovation. (News) - 2024-10-20

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: A spotlight on the fast paced growth and major deals happening across the Middle East and Africa; linking the market drivers from overnight in the US and across Asia into the region's trading day, with deep dive analysis of the top business, energy and geopolitical stories shaping the decisions of traders across the Middle East, Africa and beyond. (Bus./financial) - 2024-05-05

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg Daybreak: Europe ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: From London, essential morning viewing to stay ahead of the day's market trends with news stories from the U.S. and Asia in the lead-up to the opening of European markets. (Bus./financial, News) - 2016-10-09

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg The Opening Trade ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: "The Opening Trade" explores things to know as markets open across Europe; analysis that isn't available anywhere else, a break-down of the biggest stories of the day and top guests who have skin in the game. (Bus./financial) - 2024-06-30

bloomberg.us.title: The Pulse with Francine Lacqua ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: "The Pulse With Francine Lacqua" is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics; based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops. (News) - 2023-06-28

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg Brief ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: "Bloomberg Brief" delivers the market news, data and analysis viewers need to set their agendas. (News) - 2023-09-17

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg Surveillance ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
bloomberg.us.description: Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern have the economy and global markets "under surveillance"; their daily conversations with leaders and decision makers from Wall Street to Washington and beyond cover the latest in business, investment, and geopolitics; no other program better positions investors and executives for the trading day. (Bus./financial, News) - 2009-08-17

bloomberg.us.title: Bloomberg Open Interest ᴸᶦᵛᵉ

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

cinemax.us.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
cinemax.us.description: Jake Pentecost is a once-promising Jaeger pilot whose legendary father gave his life to secure humanity's victory against the monstrous Kaiju. Jake has since abandoned his training only to become caught up in a criminal underworld. But when an even more unstoppable threat is unleashed to tear through cities and bring the world to its knees, Jake is given one last chance by his estranged sister, Mako Mori, to live up to his father's legacy. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
cinemax.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Open Water
cinemax.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama, Horror) - 2003

cinemax.us.title: The Predator
cinemax.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Wonka
cinemax.us.description: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time. (Family, Musical comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Take the Lead
cinemax.us.description: When internationally renowned dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a teaching job in a New York City public school, he meets ridicule from the street-wise students, who scoff at the notion of ballroom dancing. Far from being discouraged, he melds their hip-hop moves with his classical style, helping them create a dance form and, in the process, becoming their mentor. (Musical, Drama) - 2006

cinemax.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemax.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Comedy drama, Biography, Docudrama) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: The Sessions
cinemax.us.description: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity. (Comedy drama, Biography) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Us
cinemax.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemax.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Thriller, Romance, Science fiction, Crime drama) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
cinemax.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: Solace
cinemax.us.description: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: The Nun
cinemax.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (Horror, Thriller) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: The Nun II
cinemax.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (Horror, Thriller) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
cinemax.us.description: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves. (Comedy, Drama) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: It
cinemax.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 1990

cinemax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
cinemax.us.description: Superstar LeBron James and his young son, Dom, get trapped in digital space by a rogue AI. To get home safely, LeBron teams up with Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against the AI's digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. (Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Animated) - 2021

cinemax.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
cinemax.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (Western, Drama) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Joshy
cinemax.us.description: Four months after the suicide of his fiancée (Alison Brie), a man (Thomas Middleditch) and his buddies (Adam Pally, Alex Ross Perry) decide to move forward with plans for a wild bachelor party. (Comedy drama) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: I Love You Forever
cinemax.us.description: Following a young woman into and out of an emotionally abusive relationship. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Shape of Water
cinemax.us.description: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank. - 2017

cinemax.us.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
cinemax.us.description: A fatherless teen starts to insinuate himself into the life of a renowned surgeon, his wife and two children. The full scope of his intent soon becomes menacingly clear when he confronts the doctor with a long-forgotten transgression. - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemax.us.description: Harley Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask and every other thug in Gotham. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. - 2020

cinemaxaction.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemaxaction.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 2020-02-05

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Whistlers
cinemaxaction.us.description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera. (Comedy drama, Crime, Movie, Thriller) - 2019-05-18

cinemaxaction.us.title: Grudge Match
cinemaxaction.us.description: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all. (Comedy, Movie) - 2013-12-25

cinemaxaction.us.title: Girls Trip
cinemaxaction.us.description: Best friends Ryan, Sasha, Lisa and Dina are in for the adventure of a lifetime when they travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. (Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2017-07-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: Wedding Crashers
cinemaxaction.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Comedy, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy) - 2005-07-15

cinemaxaction.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
cinemaxaction.us.description: Superstar LeBron James and his young son, Dom, get trapped in digital space by a rogue AI. To get home safely, LeBron teams up with Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against the AI's digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2021-07-14

cinemaxaction.us.title: Nerve
cinemaxaction.us.description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. (Action, Adventure, Crime, Crime drama, Movie) - 2016-07-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemaxaction.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2017-05-26

cinemaxaction.us.title: Aniara
cinemaxaction.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. (Drama, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2018-09-07

cinemaxaction.us.title: Body at Brighton Rock
cinemaxaction.us.description: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run and do the harder job of staying put. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2019-03-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
cinemaxaction.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (Documentary, Drama, Movie, Western) - 2024-05-19

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Alto Knights
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the 1950s, notorious New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the city streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie) - 2025-03-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2024-03-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Tomb Raider
cinemaxaction.us.description: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 2018-03-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Shot Caller
cinemaxaction.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2017-06-17

cinemaxaction.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
cinemaxaction.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2013-02-06

cinemaxaction.us.title: Man Down
cinemaxaction.us.description: When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2015-09-06

cinemaxaction.us.title: Smoking Tigers
cinemaxaction.us.description: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends. (Drama, Movie) - 2023-06-10

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Return of Godzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: Okumura witnesses a huge monster during a storm. Biologist Hayashida hears Okumura's story from Toto Nippo reporter Maki and concludes that Godzilla, who was buried 30 years ago, has come back to life. Godzilla then appears in Tokyo Bay. (Action, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1984-12-15

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Hitcher
cinemaxaction.us.description: While transporting a car from Chicago to San Diego, Jim Halsey (C. Thomas Howell) picks up a hitchhiker named John Ryder (Rutger Hauer), who claims to be a serial killer. After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders. (Action, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 1986-05-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Epic
cinemaxaction.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (Action, Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children) - 2013-05-22

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Flash
cinemaxaction.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2023-06-14

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Player
cinemaxaction.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 1992-04-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Man
cinemaxaction.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 2005-09-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Due Date
cinemaxaction.us.description: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Dark comedy, Drama, Movie) - 2010-11-05

cinemaxaction.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemaxaction.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Biography, Comedy, Comedy drama, Docudrama, Drama) - 2023-09-08

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hué. (Drama, Historical drama, Movie, War) - 1987-06-01

cinemaxclassics.us.title: A History of Violence
cinemaxclassics.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. cinemaxwest.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama, Horror) - 2003

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Predator
cinemaxwest.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: Wonka
cinemaxwest.us.description: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time. (Family, Musical comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

cinemaxwest.us.title: Take the Lead
cinemaxwest.us.description: When internationally renowned dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a teaching job in a New York City public school, he meets ridicule from the street-wise students, who scoff at the notion of ballroom dancing. Far from being discouraged, he melds their hip-hop moves with his classical style, helping them create a dance form and, in the process, becoming their mentor. (Musical, Drama) - 2006

cinemaxwest.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemaxwest.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Comedy drama, Biography, Docudrama) - 2023

cinemaxwest.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemaxwest.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Sessions
cinemaxwest.us.description: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity. (Comedy drama, Biography) - 2012

cinemaxwest.us.title: Us
cinemaxwest.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2019

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemaxwest.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Thriller, Romance, Science fiction, Crime drama) - 2011

cinemaxwest.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
cinemaxwest.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

cinemaxwest.us.title: Solace
cinemaxwest.us.description: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2015

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Nun
cinemaxwest.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (Horror, Thriller) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Nun II
cinemaxwest.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (Horror, Thriller) - 2023

cinemaxwest.us.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
cinemaxwest.us.description: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves. (Comedy, Drama) - 2024

cinemaxwest.us.title: It
cinemaxwest.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 1990

cinemaxwest.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxwest.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

cinemaxwest.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
cinemaxwest.us.description: Superstar LeBron James and his young son, Dom, get trapped in digital space by a rogue AI. To get home safely, LeBron teams up with Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against the AI's digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. (Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Animated) - 2021

freeform.us.title: Dr. Seuss' The Grinch
freeform.us.description: The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbors in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realizes there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 2018

freeform.us.title: The Good Dinosaur
freeform.us.description: Luckily for young Arlo, his parents (Jeffrey Wright, Frances McDormand) and his two siblings, the mighty dinosaurs were not wiped out 65 million years ago. When a rainstorm washes poor Arlo (Raymond Ochoa) downriver, he ends up bruised, battered and miles away from home. Good fortune shines on the frightened dino when he meets Spot (Jack Bright), a Neanderthal boy who offers his help and friendship. Together, the unlikely duo embark on an epic adventure to reunite Arlo with his beloved family. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2015

Finally, after decades of seeing all the glory go to Felix, Ralph decides to take matters into his own hands. He sets off on a game-hopping trip to prove that he has what it takes to be a hero. However, while on his quest, Ralph accidentally unleashes a deadly enemy that threatens the entire arcade. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2012

freeform.us.title: Ralph Breaks the Internet

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - The More the Merrier
golfpass.us.description: LPGA legend Lorena Ochoa joins the players to compete in a challenge, and a difficult decision leads to a shocking elimination.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Little Strokes Fell Great Oaks
golfpass.us.description: The competition intensifies as teams merge and the focus on individuals is magnified.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Playing With Fire Is Dangerous
golfpass.us.description: Some unfinished business is settled, leaving one player fighting for survival.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Choose the Lesser Evil
golfpass.us.description: A crucial decision at the start of the semifinal matches impact who will compete in the championship match.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - The Final Chapter
golfpass.us.description: The championship match reveals who will earn the top prize and be given the illustrious title of "Big Break Champion.".

golfpass.us.title: Big Break: Where Are They Now? - Don Donatello & Stefanie Kenoyer; Al Del Greco
golfpass.us.description: Don Donatello earned notoriety for his outbursts and antics, but quickly became heralded as a gritty competitor. Appearances on Big Break IV U.S. vs. Europe and Big Break Reunion solidified Donatello as legendary.

golfpass.us.title: 5 Clubs With Gary Williams
golfpass.us.description: Viewpoints of people in the game with people who love the game; we discuss what is of interest to them in the vast and deep reservoir of stories within the game of golf.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 15: KPMG Women's PGA Championship
golfpass.us.description: Blair O'Neal and Martin Hall cover everything from tee to green.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 16: Short Game Special
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal hit the course at The Club at Ibis to teach the shots needed for success on and around the green. Martin also shares short game advice from Jack Nicklaus and Seve Ballesteros.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 17: Open Golf
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach how to play links-style golf like an Open Champion. Learn how to handle the wind like 5-time Open Champion Tom Watson, get up-and-down around the green like 3-time Open Champion Gary Player.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 18: Summer School
golfpass.us.description: Martin gives a lesson on the role of the lead wrist in the golf swing; 3 tips to improve your short game; a ball striking secret from 3-time Senior Open champion Bernhard Langer; how your shadow can be used as a swing aid.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 19: Champions Train
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall shares a drill that helped Jack Nicklaus stop the sway, teaches how Phil Mickelson trains his tempo and reveals why Nick Price used a baseball bat as a swing aid.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 24: Scramble for Scores
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach how to chip it close and sink the short putt to help you scramble for scores; how to use your thumbs to control trajectory around the green; a lesson on Zen putting to help you handle the pressure on the greens.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 25: Make Practice Fun
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach how to practice competitively without feeling like you are practicing; long game drills to work on shaping your drives; a fun and useful way to strike every short game shot; how to find your perfect putting pace.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 26: Sports Skills
golfpass.us.description: How skills from other sports such as football, baseball, basketball and hockey can improve the golf swing.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 27: Putting Pointers
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal discuss how to make more putts. Martin teaches several drills to groove one's stroke and increase consistency on the greens. Martin and Blair draw upon PGA Champions Dave Stockton and Tiger Woods for inspiration.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Mike Adams
golfpass.us.description: Chris Como visits with Mike Adams and reveals how to teach the golf swing based on specific body types. Mike demonstrates how the proper grip, backswing, and footwork are decided by your body's measurements.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Joey D
golfpass.us.description: Chris Como works out with Joey D, the fitness trainer to golf's longest hitters Dustin Johnson and Brooks Koepka. Learn what band exercises create better body rotation and which medicine ball sequences help increase power.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - George Gankas
golfpass.us.description: George Gankas teaches setup position, backswing and downswing. From Westlake Golf Course in Westlake Village, Calif.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Jorge Parada
golfpass.us.description: Chris Como goes to New York to learn how up-and-coming coach Jorge Parada developed the swings of several prominent LPGA Tour players.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Sam Ryder & Adam Schriber
golfpass.us.description: Chris Como joins PGA Tour player Sam Ryder and his coach Adam Schriber in New York. Ryder and Schriber reveal drills they use on the range to keep Sam's game in shape and exercises they deploy in the gym to add speed and flexibility.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Rick Shiels
golfpass.us.description: Bones takes on the role of caddie for YouTube sensation Rick Shiels, giving viewers an inside look at the strategies used by major champions. Rick gets in-depth advice for a variety of shots, and he gives insight on how to build confidence.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Rick Shiels
golfpass.us.description: Bones takes on the role of caddie in Part 2 of this 2-part series with YouTube sensation Rick Shiels where they go in-depth on how shot shape and club selection are critical on a windy day; Rick picks Bones' brain on a variety of shots.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Super Immunity
golfpass.us.description: The players compete for a season-long Super Immunity prize, which could give one competitor a distinct advantage over his/her opponents.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Making Decisions
golfpass.us.description: The player holding Super Immunity receives an extra incentive to stay out of the elimination challenge. Competitors must make crucial decisions to earn immunity, and one player attempts to bait the competition into an early exit from the show.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - In or Out
golfpass.us.description: Players must traverse the flop wall and successfully predict their opponents' outcomes in order to gain immunity; a questionable strategy threatens to send one player home.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Team Knockout
golfpass.us.description: Players must choose teams at breakfast; and one captain bases selections on personal relationships. Meanwhile, another player makes no friends in a move that turns the entire series on an emotional roller coaster.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Tight Rope
golfpass.us.description: Competitors must rely on one another to earn safety as team formats rule the challenges. A shaky performance must be overcome to keep the Super Immunity out of play, while an unexpected twist sends players directly to the elimination challenge.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - A Putt for the Win
golfpass.us.description: A distinctive golf course feature becomes the setting for high drama as the players battle for immunity. One competitor's timely use of a mulligan earns safety, setting up an elimination match which comes down to the last putt.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Pawleys Plantation
golfpass.us.description: The remaining competitors take a road trip south on the Grand Strand, where choosing the right opponents could prove lucrative for one player. Accuracy off the tee is tested, and an untimely error threatens to derail one contestant's dream.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Limbo Wall
golfpass.us.description: As the field dwindles, players must negotiate the limbo wall to secure immunity. One competitor commits a costly mental mistake which could lead to disaster. A surprise development brings Super Immunity back into the discussion.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Final Five
golfpass.us.description: The competition heats up and one of the most impressive shots in Big Break history highlights the fight for safety. The endgame for Super Immunity is in sight as the final four participants are determined.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Final Four
golfpass.us.description: The four remaining players vie for an advantage which will go a long way toward determining who will play in the championship match.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Championship Match
golfpass.us.description: Two competitors remain. Only one will be crowned Champion of Big Break Florida. From the Omni Amelia Island Plantation Resort in Amelia Island, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Make or Break
golfpass.us.description: Twelve contestants square off in the glass break competition with bragging rights and immunity on the line. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Secret Strength
golfpass.us.description: The contestants choose to show their fellow competitors a taste of what they're in for this season as some tiptoe the line between cocky and confident. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Place Your Bets
golfpass.us.description: The contestants face a challenge that's part strategy, part gamesmanship, part skill, and part luck as they're forced to assess each other's games to survive elimination. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Corporal Clutch
golfpass.us.description: One of the cast's favorites is put to the test in a grueling day of golf that will test everyone's mettle. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Is Your Game in Shape?
golfpass.us.description: The remaining contestants get creative and look to earn immunity by showing whose game is in the best shape. Some find out they may need more work than they thought. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Carry Your Weight
golfpass.us.description: Contestants are forced to go long and see who's got the most confidence in their long game. Those who are successful will find out that confidence pays off. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Unlock the Secret
golfpass.us.description: The remaining contestants look for the right combination to unlock success with their short games. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Declaration of Independence
golfpass.us.description: Bold declarations are made, and the remaining contestants must live up to their own expectations if they hope to survive and advance. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Final Four
golfpass.us.description: Accuracy will be tested as the final four contestants become the final three. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - The Bear Trap Games
golfpass.us.description: The final three competitors take on a stretch of holes that includes the infamous Bear Trap to determine who will play for the title.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Finale
golfpass.us.description: It all comes down to this. Two players, 18 holes, match play, and in the end only one will walk away with the title Big Break Champion. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

Also featured is music from the Shadow Mountain Community Church Choir and Orchestra, as well as performances by musical guests that have included Steve Green and Charles Billingsley. Men and women who have been impacted by the Turning Point ministry also share their stories with viewers. During the month of December, "Turning Point" usually features special Christmas programming. (Religious) - 2000-04-02

history.us.title: The UnXplained Special Presentation - Biblical Artifacts
history.us.description: From relics like the Ark of the Covenant and the Holy Grail, to a tower that could touch heaven, the crew attempts to uncover the real history of biblical artifacts and the possible powers that they possess. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2023-10-17

history.us.title: The UnXplained Special Presentation - Decoding Genius
history.us.description: Discussing whether genius is born or made; whether clues can be found by examining the brains of extraordinary thinkers like Albert Einstein. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2024-04-22

history.us.title: The UnXplained Special Presentation - Secrets of Ancient Civilizations
history.us.description: Uncovering the secrets behind ancient cultures and civilizations such as the Mayan empire, the Khmer people at Angkor Wat and the Roman city of Pompeii. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2024-04-26

history.us.title: The UnXplained Special Presentation - Encountering Evil
history.us.description: While many believe that there is some darkness in our world, people wonder if it's something that emanates from strange locations, something that tempts humanity, or a feeling that invades. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2024-10-29

history.us.title: The UnXplained Special Presentation - Legendary Weapons
history.us.description: Do certain weapons recorded in the pages of history, like the dagger of King Tut or the Swords of Damascus, actually contain incredible power? (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2025-10-07

history.us.title: The UnXplained Special Presentation - Monster Mayhem
history.us.description: Analyzing if monsters exist, creatures who lurk in dense forests or fly over large cities; for centuries, monsters like Mothman, the Thunderbird, and Bigfoot have mystified witnesses, skeptics, and scientists alike; discussing what people can learn from encounters reported around the globe with beasts they don't yet understand. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2024-05-20

history.us.title: The UnXplained Special Presentation - Powerful Predictions
history.us.description: Throughout history, many prophecies and figures like Liu Bowen and the Oracle of Delphi, who claim to see the future, influence powerful nations; predicting the future remains either an inherited trait or a learned skill; this ability exists as a rare gift for a select few or a capacity accessible to everyone who opens their mind. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2025-10-14

history.us.title: The UnXplained Special Presentation - Dark Forces
history.us.description: Exploring if dark, powerful energies permeate the human world, or if it is all just myth and superstition. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2023-10-31

history.us.title: The UnXplained Special Presentation - Beyond Death
history.us.description: Throughout human history, how the dead are treated is as important as how the living are treated, and questions of both death and the afterlife have been at the heart of every known culture. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2024-10-09

history.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Dodging Death
history.us.description: A brush with death is terrifying enough-but these stories take survival to the extreme; like fending off a black bear while dangling off a cliff; drifting through shark-infested waters with nothing but a pair of rubber boots to stay afloat; just when you think skydiving is the real danger-try crash-landing into a nest of thousands of angry fire ants. (Documentary, History, Anthology) - 2025-12-19

history.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Astonishing Bodies
history.us.description: From a headless chicken that lives over one year, to an out-of-this-world "celestial body" where it rains molten glass, the team explores the most astonishing bodies through these truly unbelievable stories. (Documentary, History, Anthology) - 2023-12-15

history.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Man vs. Nature
history.us.description: Mother Nature doesn't always play nice, whether it's a mile-long sinkhole, a biblical swarm of crop-killing grasshoppers or an invasion of rum-fueled monkeys running wild on the island of St. Kitts; stories where humans go head-to-head with nature. (Documentary, History, Anthology) - 2025-12-05

history.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Strange Sightings
history.us.description: From stone-throwing jungle apes, to swarms of sinister clowns stalking the suburbs, to skies raining down murderous birds, these are the strange encounters that leave the experts scratching their heads.

history.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Sweet Revenge
history.us.description: Studying stories of revenge, such as the one about a man in Colorado that uses a Killdozer to settle a zoning dispute or another about an emperor who pickles his wife's lover; exploring vengeance seekers who take things too far.

history.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Super Secret Weapons ᴺᵉʷ
history.us.description: Bombs full of scorpions, exploding dummy paratroopers, and spy kits hidden where the sun don't shine, these super-secret weapons are as bizarre as they are deadly.

history.us.title: Mysteries From Above - Deep Sea Mysteries ᴺᵉʷ
history.us.description: Coming face to face with a superpod of dolphins in New Zealand and examining swirling spirals beneath the surface of the Pacific; learning why the turquoise Strait of Georgia suddenly turns white; spotting a structure that sneaks around the ocean.
