filmriseclassictv.us.title: Death Valley Days - The Man Who'd Bet on Anything
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Abe Curry wants to make a difference in Carson City but takes reckless chances with his money. (Anthology, Western) - 1956-01-16

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Death Valley Days - Nevada's Plymouth Rock
filmriseclassictv.us.description: In a Nevada mining town, a woman dealing with a sick son and a broke husband longs to move back East, but an Army major helps change her mind. (Anthology, Western) - 1956-02-13

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Death Valley Days - The Hoodoo Mine
filmriseclassictv.us.description: A prospector, double-crossed by his partner and left to die in the desert, finds salvation in an Indian girl named Lupin who puts a curse on his would-be killer. (Anthology, Western) - 1956-03-02

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief. (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Crime drama, Romance) - 2008

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gang of Roses
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew. (Western, Action) - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Going All the Way
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war. (Drama) - 1997

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Heathers
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty). (Dark comedy, Crime drama) - 1989

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Gunman
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Code
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob. (Crime drama) - 2009

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond. (Drama, Fantasy, War) - 1999

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blind Horizon
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her. (Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 2004

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond. (Horror, Thriller) - 1980

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Long Walk Home
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better. (Historical drama) - 1990

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A boy (Julian Dennison) and his foster father (Sam Neill) become the subjects of a manhunt after they get stranded in the New Zealand wilderness. (Comedy, Adventure) - 2016

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Cold Blood
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways. (Action, Thriller) - 2019

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Straight A's
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: At the behest of his mother's ghost, an addict (Ryan Phillippe) returns to his Louisiana home, where he must confront an ex-lover (Anna Paquin) who is now married to his brother. (Romantic comedy) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: I'm Charlie Walker
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him. (Drama) - 2022

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Jack's Back
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 1988

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Mysteria
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Aleister Bain (Robert Miano), a whiskey-soaked and washed-up Hollywood screenwriter, desperately struggles to finish a script. (Mystery) - 2011

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Getaway
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive. (Action, Adventure, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1994

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Eye See You
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Hit & Run
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down. (Comedy, Action, Adventure) - 2012

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Contract
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Are You Here
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After his eccentric pal (Zach Galifianakis) inherits a fortune from his estranged father, an aimless, womanizing weatherman (Owen Wilson) becomes involved in the legal battle initiated by his friend's sister (Amy Poehler). (Comedy drama) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Just Getting Started
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: 10th and Wolf
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them. (Drama) - 2006

hgtvwest.us.description: S201 E09 Making Music in Portugal After dreaming of moving to Europe for decades, a couple relocates to Portugal for a new job; they search for a home near the city center that includes space for a dedicated music studio.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S202 E08 Villa Dreams or City Schemes in Denia, Spain A couple and their two dogs leave the overwhelming cost of San Diego for a better work-life balance in Denia, Spain; she wants to live the dream in a big Spanish villa at any cost, but he prefers a place near the city center that's in their budget.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S205 E08 Chanting From Atlanta to Amsterdam After 10 years in Atlanta, a couple looks to move with their young daughter back to her family roots in Amsterdam; they're looking for a place near their temple and relocating for her is easy, but he may be in store for an inevitable culture clash.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S202 E03 The Price of Pura Vida Perfection in Costa Rica A couple and their tween daughter hope to escape the Canadian cold for Pura Vida in Playas del Coco, Costa Rica; their wish list is loaded with big spaces and awe-inspiring views, but they may have to pivot thanks to the prodigious price of paradise.

hgtvwest.us.title: Bachelor Mansion Takeover
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E06 The Final Challenge Bachelor Nation's final four designers face off for the last time, chasing the $100,000 grand prize. Two high-stakes eliminations narrow the field to a final showdown in the ultimate challenge: the kitchen. Who has the talent to win it all?

hgtvwest.us.title: No Demo Reno
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E02 Porcelain Punch Up With their kids off to school, a couple finally has the time to renovate their house; Jenn is ready to lean into their casual and traditional style, but there's trouble in No Demo City as Jenn and Victor clash over some porcelain countertops.

hgtvwest.us.title: No Demo Reno
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E03 Bachelor Pad A man and his two older sons move back in together after the passing of their wife and mother; Jenn delivers a modern space with rustic and industrial elements that recognize the past while ushering hope for the future.

hgtvwest.us.title: No Demo Reno
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E05 Fresh Start A couple began renovations on their home when he suddenly passed away; now, Jenn is taking the reins to help her finish their dream home, bringing a traditional yet modern design that will keep his spirit alive while giving her a fresh start.

hgtvwest.us.title: Extreme Buyers Club
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E01 Living Room Llamas Noel Collier takes on two different house hunts: one for a woman with 40 llamas and a kangaroo, and another for a couple seeking a Texas home with an underground bunker; from pets to prepping, Noel proves no request is too unusual.

hgtvwest.us.title: Extreme Buyers Club
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E03 Victorian Vibes and Mermaid Dives Noel joins a macabre-loving couple who are searching for a Victorian home that can accommodate their growing collection of vintage oddities; scuba instructors and professional mermaid performers hunt for a property with acreage and a training pool.

hgtvwest.us.title: Extreme Buyers Club
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E06 A Place to Land Noel takes on a 30-year-old deaf little person who's searching for an accessible first home, but his budget may stand in the way; a visionary looks for the perfect property to transform a retired Boeing 727 into a one-of-a-kind vacation rental.

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E01 Stay for A-Wild Jack McBrayer hits the road to find unique homes in the U.S. and kicks things off at a home shaped like an actual shoe; he checks out an off-the-grid eco-house and stops by a hitmaker's hideaway.

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E02 Where the Trolls Live Jack explores more unique and wild homes including a jam-packed mansion with a 25-seat movie theater, a replica mineshaft home situated on over 300 acres and a mountain home featuring a jungle theme and hidden rooms.

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E03 The Good, the Bad, the Wild Jack is back on the hunt for the wildest homes, starting with a recently purchased homestead that puts the wild in Wild West; he also visits a quirky, whimsical house and a sailor's dream dwelling that are both for sale and ready for new owners.

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E04 We Need to Steal a Chair Jack tours a French country-inspired mansion filled with ornate details and then a pink dream home bursting with playful decor; a Spanish hacienda purchased on a whim full of colorful tiles and enchanting gardens that took 21 years to complete.

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E06 Halo Effect Jack's search for wild homes continues with more houses for sale: an artist's Technicolor high-rise and a serene angelic retreat; he visits a newly bought round home that has no flat walls or angles.

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E08 Bottle-ottle-ottle Off to find more wild homes, Jack climbs up to a treetop oasis made from salvaged materials; then, he tours a property made out of glass bottles and visits a 19th century home that turned three structures into one unexpected residence.

logo.us.title: Mama's Family - An Affair to Forget

logo.us.title: Mama's Family - Mr. Wrong

logo.us.title: Mama's Family - Mama Fights Back

retroplex.us.title: The Carson City Kid
retroplex.us.description: The Carson City Kid (Roy Rogers) stops stagecoaches traveling between Wild West mining towns, searching their mail sacks for letters addressed to Morgan Reynolds, the man who killed his brother. Discovering that Reynolds operates a saloon under the name Lee Jessup (Bob Steele), the Kid takes a job as the saloon's bouncer. While vying with Reynolds for the affections of singer Joby Madison (Pauline Moore), the Kid discovers a swindled miner (Noah Beery Jr.) who claims to be the Carson City Kid. (Western) - 1940

retroplex.us.title: Lights of Old Santa Fe
retroplex.us.description: In this musical western, Marjorie Brooks (Dale Evans) is the owner and operator of a rodeo that's an antiquated touring company on its last legs. Her business rival, Frank Madden (Richard Powers), offers to combine their operations if the lovely Marjorie will be his bride. Though she initially rebuffs his proposal, a canceled booking tips the scales and forces Marjorie to accept. But rodeo rider Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) suspects Frank is behind Marjorie's troubles and sets out to investigate. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
retroplex.us.description: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing. (Western) - 1941

retroplex.us.title: The Trail Beyond
retroplex.us.description: Fresh out of college, American Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to assist in the search for missing people in Canada. Accompanied by Wabi (Noah Beery Jr.), his friend from school, Drew travels north, but quickly gets into a confrontation with a gang of French Canadian outlaws. When the bandits abduct the young Felice Newsome (Verna Hillie), it becomes apparent they're responsible for the other disappearances as well. Luckily, Drew and Wabi are there, determined to find and free the captives. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Senorita
retroplex.us.description: Things go from bad to worse for singing cowboy Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and his trusty companion, Teddy Bear (Guinn "Big Boy" Williams), when, after losing their jobs at a local café, the pair are accused of having kidnapped young Chip Williams (Mary Lee) who, in reality, is merely a runaway who's been tagging along with the cowpokes. But amidst these problems, Roy and his partner decide to team up with the girl and her half-sister, Ysobel (Dale Evans), and search for some long-buried treasure. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: Sagebrush Trail
retroplex.us.description: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose. (Western) - 1933

retroplex.us.title: Outlaws of the Plains
retroplex.us.description: An impressionable cowpoke, Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), hears a voice claiming to be that of an old Native American, telling him the location of some hidden gold. Fuzzy does find gold, but the land has already been claimed by Nord Finner (Charles King Jr.). Finner offers to sell his claim, and Fuzzy is eager to buy. Then Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe), a friend of Fuzzy's, shows up and discovers that a gang of outlaws is behind a scheme to rob everyone in the area. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Romance of the West
retroplex.us.description: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), along with his sidekick, Ezra (Emmett Lynn), oversees the peaceful coexistence of the Native American tribes with the white settlers of Antelope Valley. The treaty that binds the two groups is threatened when some of the town leaders learn that the Native American land contains rich deposits of silver. Eager to oust the tribes and claim the silver, the town leaders try to provoke an attack that would break the treaty. It's up to Eddie to stop them in time. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Panhandle
retroplex.us.description: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Border Feud
retroplex.us.description: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Paradise Canyon
retroplex.us.description: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns). (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
retroplex.us.description: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Under California Stars

Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Jericho
retroplex.us.description: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho. (Western, Mystery) - 2000

retroplex.us.title: Chappaquiddick

thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E02 Auburndale: Regulations and Challenges Removing old yews; demolishing a sun porch; a visit to the estate's original gatehouse; progress on excavation out front and back; a team of concrete cutters cuts through 10-inch-thick concrete foundation walls.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E03 Auburndale: Bringing in the Structure A crane lifts a steel beam that will carry the load of the house; insulated concrete forms for the foundations and above-grade walls on the additions; pouring the foundation and walls; lead laws; the kitchen is gutted; the dining room wall goes down.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E05 Auburndale: A New Approach to the House New front entry; framed-up kitchen; Tom turns the flat roof into a pitched one with prefabricated trusses; kitchen layout; Roger shows Kevin the native and non-native species taking over the flood plain; the layout for the new back deck and walkways.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E06 Auburndale: The Artistry of TOH and Jules Aarons Framing a slightly pitched roof over a new sunroom; tapering LVLs; roof rafters; installing deck underlayment; an expensive change order in a bathroom; a former resident of the home was street photographer Jules Aarons; back-to-back bathrooms.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E07 Auburndale: Progress On All Levels Richard finishes up installation of the floor-warming radiant heat under the new family room; a new basement floor and footings are poured, smoothed and leveled; Tom installs the new energy efficient, vinyl clad casement windows.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E09 Auburndale: Stucco, Kitchen Design, Roof, and Insulation Work on the exterior is progressing; using an acrylic stucco system in the basement; waterproofing the valley where the flat roof meets the pitched roof of the new entry addition; installing four different kinds of insulation throughout the house.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

classica.us.title: Approaching the Maelstrom
classica.us.description: Der Dokumentarfilm aus dem Jahr 2019 verfolgt den Prozess, der zu einer Aufnahme der Komposition "A Descent into the Maelström" des US-amerikanischen Komponisten Philip Glass führte. Das Werk basiert auf dem Werk des Schriftstellers Edgar Allan Poe. (Documentary, Music) - 2019

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 4 in B-Dur, op. 60
classica.us.description: "Les Dissonances" spielen die 4. Sinfonie von Ludwig van Beethoven an der Opéra Dijon. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2013-01-01

classica.us.title: Schubert -- Rondo D. 951
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmete sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich der Kammermusik. Auf dem Programm standen unter anderem Felix Mendelssohns Klaviertrio Nr. 1 in d-Moll, Op. 49 und Franz Schuberts Rondo in A-Dur, D. 951. (Special, Event) - 2025-06-05

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Letzte Sonate Op. 109, 110 & 111
classica.us.description: Seine drei letzten Sonaten widmet Beethoven den intimen Dynamiken der menschlichen Seele, die von Verzweiflung bis Verwandlung reichen. Im Film werden die Musikwerke mit Szenen in verlassenen Schlössern untermalt, die an Einsamkeit erinnern. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2019-11-23

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Klavierkonzert Nr. 1 und Sinfonie Nr. 2
classica.us.description: Im Alter von sieben Jahren debütierte Martha Argerich mit Ludwig van Beethovens Klavierkonzert Nr. 1. In diesem Konzert beim Luzern Festival spielt die gefeierte Pianistin das berühmte Werk mit dem Luzern Festival Orchester. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2023-06-10

classica.us.title: Schostakowitsch - Concertino für zwei Klaviere
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmet sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich dem Repertoire für Klavier und Violine in diesem wunderbaren Konzert, das im Château de Chantilly in Frankreich aufgezeichnet wurde. (Special, Music) - 2025-05-31

classica.us.title: Die drei Leben der Clara Schumann
classica.us.description: Die Biografie von Clara Schumann ist legendenumwoben: Ihre strenge Kindheit, ihr außergewöhnliches Talent als Pianistin, ihre frühe Liebe zum Komponisten Robert Schumann und die Erziehung von sieben Kindern bieten Material für Mythen und Klischees. (Special, Documentary) - 2019-09-15

classica.us.title: Chopin - Polonaise-Fantasie, op. 61
classica.us.description: Die in der Ukraine geborene Pianistin Inna Faliks spielt Frederic Chopins Polonaise-Fantasie Op. 61. Aufgenommen in der Nicols Konzert Hall in Evanston. Faliks hat sich als eine der poetischsten Künstlerinnen ihrer Generation etabliert. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-08-11

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Mahler, Symphonie Nr. 6 a-Moll
classica.us.description: Gustav Mahler (1860-1911): Symphonie Nr. 6 a-Moll. Paavo Järvi dirigiert das hr-Sinfonieorchester. Aufgenommen beim Rheingau Musik Festival im Kloster Eberbach. Der österreichische Komponist und Dirigent Gustav Mahler führte die traditionsreiche Gattung der Symphonie ins 20. Jahrhundert. Seine Werke sind heute Bestandteil des Standardrepertoires jedes großen Orchesters. (Special, Music, Event) - 2015-08-26

classica.us.title: Kammermusik von Haydn, Tschaikowski und anderen
classica.us.description: Dieses Kammermusikkonzert ist Teil der Konzertreihe Präludium der Hochschule für Musik Reina Sofía in Madrid. Das Programm beginnt mit Joseph Haydns Konzert in D-Dur für Violoncello und Orchester, H VIIb: 2, aufgeführt von Pareja und Chavaldas. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-08-12

classica.us.title: Hans van Manen: Moving to Music
classica.us.description: Reflexionen von Freunden und Kollegen, die Details der Choreographie von Hans van Manen enthüllen. (Special, Documentary, Dance, Ballet)

classica.us.title: Bach - 3. Sonate für Violin (BWV 1005)
classica.us.description: Isabelle Faust spielt zwei unglaubliche Solowerke für Violine von J. S. Bach: Partita Nr. 2 in d-Moll BWV 1004 und Sonate Nr. 3 in C-Dur BWV 1005. Beide Werke sind Teil der bekannten Sonaten und Solo-Partiten für Violine des Komponisten. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-05-31

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 8
classica.us.description: Mahlers 8. Symphonie, auch bekannt als die Symphonie der Tausend, ist ein monumentales Chor-Epos aus dem Jahr 1906, das ein riesiges Ensemble aus Solisten, Chören und einem gewaltigen Orchester erfordert. (Special) - 2026-03-28

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgischen Konzerte, BWV 1046-1051
classica.us.description: Václav Luks dirigiert das Collegium 1704 in Johann Sebastian Bachs Brandenburgische Konzerte 1-6. Im Jubiläumsjahr 2021 wurden sie im neu restaurierten Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses mit dem Collegium 1704 aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2022-02-20

classica.us.title: Mahler, Symphonie Nr. 1 D-Dur
classica.us.description: Die Wiener Philharmoniker unter der Leitung von Leonard Bernstein spielen die Symphonie Nr. 1 D-Dur von Gustav Mahler (1860-1911). Diese Aufnahme entstand im Oktober 1974 im Wiener Konzerthaus. Als erster Dirigent nahm Leonard Bernstein alle Symphonien Gustav Mahlers nicht nur auf Schallplatte, sondern auch auf Video auf. Bernsteins Mahler-Zyklus ist ein einzigartiges musikalisches Dokument und trug zu einem neuen Verständnis von Mahlers Werk bei. (Special, Music) - 2012-12-06

classica.us.title: Liszt - Zwei sinfonische Dichtungen
classica.us.description: Franz Liszt verfasste 13 sinfonische Dichtungen, die von literarischen Texten inspiriert waren. Der Komponist schrieb Klavier-Duette für diese Dichtungen, die sein beeindruckendes Talent zeigten, ein volles Orchester mit nur einem Piano zu imitieren. (Special, Music) - 2025-08-15

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 2, Op. 36
classica.us.description: Martha Argerich spielt mit dem Lucerne Festival Orchestra unter der Leitung von Herbert Blomstedt Beethovens zweite Sinfonie. Diese Aufführung wurde im August 2020 im Kultur- und Kongresszentrum Luzern in der Schweiz aufgenommen. (Special, Event, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2023-07-04

classica.us.title: Martha Argerich - Eine Geburtstagsfeier - III
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmet sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich dem Kammermusikrepertoire in einem wunderbaren Konzert. Die "Grande Dame des Klaviers" wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet. (Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-09-21

classica.us.title: Orff: Carmina Burana
classica.us.description: Die von Carl Orff komponierten „Carmina Burana" sind in den Jahren 1935 und 1936 entstanden. Die Kantate basiert auf 24 Gedichten aus der gleichnamigen mittelalterlichen Sammlung, bestehend aus zumeist lateinischen Lied- und Dramentexten. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert, Event) - 2020-01-01

classica.us.title: Cartoons in Concert
classica.us.description: Beliebte Figuren aus der Welt der Cartoons und Animationsfilme treffen im Konzertsaal auf eine mitreißende musikalische Fusion. Gemeinsam mit Chören und Orchestern des DR entsteht ein einzigartiges Konzerterlebnis. Seien Sie gespannt! (Special, Music, Concert) - 2024-12-24

classica.us.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C-Dur, Op. 17
classica.us.description: Nachdem er alle 32 Beethoven Klaviersonaten aufgenommen hat, um den 250. Geburtstag des Komponisten zu feiern, entschied sich der gefeierte italienische Pianist Riccardo Schwarz dazu, Soloklavierwerke von Robert Schumann aufzunehmen. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-11-28

moviesphere.us.description: An agoraphobic gamer agrees to test new equipment that uses AI to interpret the electrical activity of her brain. Soon, the line between reality and her subconscious starts to blur as she wonders if the device is serving a sinister force. (Movie, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2024-06-14

moviesphere.us.title: Moonfall
moviesphere.us.description: The world stands on the brink of annihilation when a mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling toward a collision course with Earth. With only weeks before impact, NASA executive Jacinda "Jo" Fowler teams up with a man from her past and a conspiracy theorist for an impossible mission into space to save humanity. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science fiction) - 2022-02-04

moviesphere.us.title: Source Code
moviesphere.us.description: Helicopter pilot Colter Stevens (Jake Gyllenhaal) is part of a top-secret military operation that enables him to experience the last few minutes in the life of Sean Fentress, a man who died in a commuter-train explosion. The purpose of Colter's mission is to learn the identity of the bomber and prevent a similar catastrophe. As Colter lives Sean's final moments, he becomes more certain that he can prevent the first tragedy from occurring -- as long as he doesn't run out of time. (Action, Movie, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2011-04-01

moviesphere.us.title: Den of Thieves
moviesphere.us.description: Nick O'Brien is the hard-drinking leader of the Regulators, an elite unit of the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department. Ray Merrimen is the recently paroled leader of the Outlaws, a gang of ex-military men who use their expertise and tactical skills to evade the law. O'Brien, Merriman and their squads soon find themselves on a direct collision course as the criminals hatch an elaborate plan for a seemingly impossible heist -- the city's Federal Reserve Bank. (Action, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2018-01-19

moviesphere.us.title: Heist
moviesphere.us.description: When their attempt to rob a gangster's (Robert De Niro) casino goes awry, a desperate man (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and his partner (Dave Bautista) hijack a city bus to escape from the police and a maniacal thug (Morris Chestnut). (Action, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2015-11-13

moviesphere.us.title: Cash Out
moviesphere.us.description: Tempted by what could be his biggest score ever, professional thief Mason joins forces with his younger brother to rob a bank. However, when the heist goes awry, the thieves find themselves trapped inside, surrounded by SWAT teams, the FBI and Interpol. Things get even more tense when Mason eventually talks to the lead negotiator -- his former lover. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2024-04-26

moviesphere.us.title: Confidence
moviesphere.us.description: In this glossy neo-noir caper, expert grifter Jake Vig (Edward Burns) inadvertently crosses volatile crime boss the King (Dustin Hoffman) and, to make it right, he must agree to con banker Morgan Price (Robert Forster). He assembles his team, including Lily (Rachel Weisz) and Gordo (Paul Giamatti), but things get complicated fast with the arrival of Special Agent Gunther Butan (Andy Garcia), who has been tracking Jake for years. As the con goes down, Jake can't say who's double crossing whom. (Crime drama, Movie) - 2003-04-25

moviesphere.us.title: Force of Nature
moviesphere.us.description: A policeman and a former cop battle a gang of thieves as they search for $55 million inside an evacuated building during a hurricane. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2020-06-23

moviesphere.us.title: Man on a Ledge
moviesphere.us.description: When disgraced ex-cop Nick Cassidy (Sam Worthington) steps onto the ledge of the highest floor of New York's famous Roosevelt Hotel, more than just his life is at risk; he threatens to bring the city to its knees. There are some very nervous people around with some very big secrets to hide. As police negotiator Lydia Spencer (Elizabeth Banks) tries to talk Nick in from the ledge, she begins to suspect that he has an ulterior motive behind his actions. (Action, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2012-01-27

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - Theories of Evolution Just Before Darwin
truehistory.us.description: The idea of evolution is in the air; looking at precursors to Darwin, including Jean-Baptiste Lamarck; Lamarck writes a systematic account of the evolution of species over time; he proposes that acquired characteristics can be inherited. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - Why Evolution Was Rejected Before Darwin
truehistory.us.description: Investigating the dubious status of evolutionary ideas in the years before Darwin's book; one objection is that evolution challenges the Bible and lacks convincing empirical support; some critics even class evolution with fringe ideas. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - Darwin's Conversion to Evolution
truehistory.us.description: A young Darwin's intention to join the ministry is interrupted by an offer to travel around the world as a naturalist aboard HMS Beagle; the experience changes his life, giving him a growing conviction that species have altered over time. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - What's in On the Origin of Species?
truehistory.us.description: Darwin spends two decades developing his theory of evolution; how he is rushed to publish prematurely by the independent discovery of the same principle by Alfred Russel Wallace; "On the Origin of Species" is a masterful statement of his idea. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: Solving for Zero: The Search for Climate Innovation - How We Got Here
truehistory.us.description: Overall warming trends have started to impact the Earth's climate; explaining the background science on how humans arrived at their current climate challenge. (Documentary, Science, Environment, History) - 2022-04-15

truehistory.us.title: Solving for Zero: The Search for Climate Innovation - This Will Be Hard
truehistory.us.description: Exploring difficulties involved in decarbonizing five key sectors that are the major sources of greenhouse gas emissions; considering the difficulty of reducing the cost of clean technologies to be as cheap as those that are used today. (Documentary, Science, Environment, History) - 2022-04-15

truehistory.us.title: Solving for Zero: The Search for Climate Innovation - How We Plug In
truehistory.us.description: Taking a look at nuclear batteries that are radically different and smaller than power plants, innovative carbon-capture solutions, and more. (Documentary, Science, Environment, History) - 2022-04-15

truehistory.us.title: Solving for Zero: The Search for Climate Innovation - How We Make Things
truehistory.us.description: Innovators discuss key breakthroughs in cement and steel production; learning why reducing the green premiums associated with them can be another essential tool. (Documentary, Science, Environment, History) - 2022-04-15

truehistory.us.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400 - Self-Interest, Human Survival, and History
truehistory.us.description: Differences between economic history and a history of economics; the primary concerns of current economic historians; watershed economic moments of the last 500 years; why modern economic history begins around 1400. (World history) - 2016-08-28

truehistory.us.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400 - Marco Polo, China, and the Silk Road Trade
truehistory.us.description: Examining the state of the global economy circa 1400, when Europe was at the bottom of the economic success ladder; the broad economic outlines of China, India, and the Islamic world; how Europe laid groundwork for the new capitalist world system. (World history) - 2016-08-28

truehistory.us.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400 - Manorial Society in Medieval Europe
truehistory.us.description: How Europe's manorial societies helped develop the structures and institutions that would lead to the medieval commercial revolution; what daily life was like on a manor; medieval trade fairs; how wool-cloth production redefined northwestern Europe. (World history) - 2016-08-28

truehistory.us.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400 - How Black Death Reshaped Town and Field
truehistory.us.description: Examining how the Black Death shut down trade routes, lowered economic productivity, disrupted supply and demand, depressed land value and ultimately made the medieval feudal system untenable. (World history) - 2016-08-28

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - Taxonomy: The Order of Life
truehistory.us.description: Learning how much the scientific name of an animal, past or present, really matters; from Carl Linnaeus' Systema Naturae to the modern system of cladistics, exploring how much can be learned about the history of life on Earth through classification. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - Minerals and the Evolving Earth
truehistory.us.description: Paleontology offers a lens to view how the planet's 4,400 minerals develop over years, both influencing and being influenced by the evolving biosphere; learning how Earth's few primordial minerals interact with liquid water; studying photosynthesis. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - Fossil Timekeepers
truehistory.us.description: The planet's fossil record reveals that the natural cycles have evolved; learning how biostratigraphy, sclerochronology, carbon-14 dating and other tools reveal a historic Earth with a day as short as six hours and a year as long as 455 days. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - Fossils and the Shifting Crust
truehistory.us.description: Learning why life on Earth is exactly where it is today; understanding why some species are found only in isolated pockets while others are spread across multiple continents; uncovering what fossils tell us about our planet's historic migrations. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - Theories of Evolution Just Before Darwin
truehistory.us.description: The idea of evolution is in the air; looking at precursors to Darwin, including Jean-Baptiste Lamarck; Lamarck writes a systematic account of the evolution of species over time; he proposes that acquired characteristics can be inherited. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - Why Evolution Was Rejected Before Darwin
truehistory.us.description: Investigating the dubious status of evolutionary ideas in the years before Darwin's book; one objection is that evolution challenges the Bible and lacks convincing empirical support; some critics even class evolution with fringe ideas. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - Darwin's Conversion to Evolution
truehistory.us.description: A young Darwin's intention to join the ministry is interrupted by an offer to travel around the world as a naturalist aboard HMS Beagle; the experience changes his life, giving him a growing conviction that species have altered over time. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - What's in On the Origin of Species?
truehistory.us.description: Darwin spends two decades developing his theory of evolution; how he is rushed to publish prematurely by the independent discovery of the same principle by Alfred Russel Wallace; "On the Origin of Species" is a masterful statement of his idea. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: Solving for Zero: The Search for Climate Innovation - How We Got Here
truehistory.us.description: Overall warming trends have started to impact the Earth's climate; explaining the background science on how humans arrived at their current climate challenge. (Documentary, Science, Environment, History) - 2022-04-15

truehistory.us.title: Solving for Zero: The Search for Climate Innovation - This Will Be Hard
truehistory.us.description: Exploring difficulties involved in decarbonizing five key sectors that are the major sources of greenhouse gas emissions; considering the difficulty of reducing the cost of clean technologies to be as cheap as those that are used today. (Documentary, Science, Environment, History) - 2022-04-15

truehistory.us.title: Solving for Zero: The Search for Climate Innovation - How We Plug In
truehistory.us.description: Taking a look at nuclear batteries that are radically different and smaller than power plants, innovative carbon-capture solutions, and more. (Documentary, Science, Environment, History) - 2022-04-15

truehistory.us.title: Solving for Zero: The Search for Climate Innovation - How We Make Things
truehistory.us.description: Innovators discuss key breakthroughs in cement and steel production; learning why reducing the green premiums associated with them can be another essential tool. (Documentary, Science, Environment, History) - 2022-04-15

truehistory.us.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400 - Self-Interest, Human Survival, and History
truehistory.us.description: Differences between economic history and a history of economics; the primary concerns of current economic historians; watershed economic moments of the last 500 years; why modern economic history begins around 1400. (World history) - 2016-08-28

truehistory.us.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400 - Marco Polo, China, and the Silk Road Trade
truehistory.us.description: Examining the state of the global economy circa 1400, when Europe was at the bottom of the economic success ladder; the broad economic outlines of China, India, and the Islamic world; how Europe laid groundwork for the new capitalist world system. (World history) - 2016-08-28

truehistory.us.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400 - Manorial Society in Medieval Europe
truehistory.us.description: How Europe's manorial societies helped develop the structures and institutions that would lead to the medieval commercial revolution; what daily life was like on a manor; medieval trade fairs; how wool-cloth production redefined northwestern Europe. (World history) - 2016-08-28

truehistory.us.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400 - How Black Death Reshaped Town and Field
truehistory.us.description: Examining how the Black Death shut down trade routes, lowered economic productivity, disrupted supply and demand, depressed land value and ultimately made the medieval feudal system untenable. (World history) - 2016-08-28

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - Taxonomy: The Order of Life
truehistory.us.description: Learning how much the scientific name of an animal, past or present, really matters; from Carl Linnaeus' Systema Naturae to the modern system of cladistics, exploring how much can be learned about the history of life on Earth through classification. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - Minerals and the Evolving Earth
truehistory.us.description: Paleontology offers a lens to view how the planet's 4,400 minerals develop over years, both influencing and being influenced by the evolving biosphere; learning how Earth's few primordial minerals interact with liquid water; studying photosynthesis. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - Fossil Timekeepers
truehistory.us.description: The planet's fossil record reveals that the natural cycles have evolved; learning how biostratigraphy, sclerochronology, carbon-14 dating and other tools reveal a historic Earth with a day as short as six hours and a year as long as 455 days. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City - Reflections On and of Pompeii
truehistory.us.description: When most people hear the name of the archeological site of Pompeii, they think of destruction; gaining an overview of the course; considering why the remains of Pompeii offer more than just a story of a cataclysm. (Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2010-09-03

truehistory.us.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City - Geology and Geography On the Bay of Naples
truehistory.us.description: Land and humankind help to shape Pompeii; examining the violent geological forces that forge the distinctive region of the Bay of Naples; tracing its influence on the surrounding geography; the various cultures that contribute to life in this area. truehistory.us.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City - The Rediscovery of Vesuvian Lands

waypointtv.us.description: S02 E04 The annual Father-Son hunt at FE Hill Outfitters becomes a tradition for Heath and his son Gavin; in 2021, Gavin is able to take his largest buck to date with his dad, Heath, behind the camera.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Disabled Outdoorsmen
waypointtv.us.description: We join Blake Barnett alongside hunter Jimmy Reynolds as they take part in the 2nd Annual Pierce Dutton Memorial Hunt. This meaningful whitetail hunt is made possible by the great folks at Disabled Outdoorsmen.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Lonestar Redfish
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E06 We find ourselves fishing with Troy from Lone Star Beer. We get to catch up in the offseason and spend a day on the water discussing future events and reflect on what all Texas has to offer.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Bucks for the Brave
waypointtv.us.description: Joining Denny McMahan at the Thumbtack Ranch in South Texas; after dedicating his life to service in the U.S. Army and law enforcement, he now continues the mission by teaching at the police academy; Denny is a hero in his community.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : The Hill
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E02 From its inception, the F E Hill Ranch creates opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories, including a tradition of fathers and sons hunting together.

waypointtv.us.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors : Season 4 Wrap Up
waypointtv.us.description: A recap of this season's favorite fish!

waypointtv.us.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors : STARS of the Lagoon
waypointtv.us.description: Blair and Leiza Fitzgerald search the Indian River Lagoon for redfish to tag for the CCA STAR Tournament.

waypointtv.us.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors : The Lagoon is Bach
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E01 Capt. Blair and Capt. Hunter Bach head back to the lagoon to catch redfish.

waypointtv.us.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors : Cape Canaveral Outcast
waypointtv.us.description: Tournament angler Blair Wiggins of "Addictive Fishing" continues his fishing adventures but also shares his love of everything outdoors, including hunting, cooking, beekeeping and more.

waypointtv.us.title: The Green Way Outdoors : The Mysterious 10,000 Islands
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E04 Kyle Green camps and explores the 10,000 islands off the west coast of Florida on his Sea-Doo while trying to catch fish after red tide.

waypointtv.us.title: The Green Way Outdoors : The Texas Gator Hunt
waypointtv.us.description: Kyle Green and Jeff Hutchinson set off to hunt gators on a lake in Texas, but things get rowdy when Kyle loses a bet and has to swim with the very gators he is hunting.

waypointtv.us.title: The Green Way Outdoors : Alaska Sockeye Salmon
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E06 The team heads to Alaska to target sockeye salmon.

waypointtv.us.title: The Green Way Outdoors : The Snakehead Fish
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E07 Kyle Green and Jeff Hutchinson head to Maryland to bow-fish for an invasive toothy fish called the snakehead; they also learn from the locals.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Drops Goes Down -- Giant GA Buck Crosses Over to the Neighbor
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E23 A buck that Tyler Jordan is trying to hunt all season wanders over to the neighbors and is shot by hunter Wesley Tyus; Tyler is able to be there for the recovery of this once-in-a-lifetime buck.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Georgia Rut Monster- Jackie Bushman Buckmaster
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E24 The Road Trips crew has been getting after it during the rut in Georgia; Tyler Jordan kills a giant buck named Crabby while Jackie Bushman, aka Buckmaster, camps with the crew.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Epic Bowhunting in Georgia - EHD Caused Broken Foot?
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E25 Bryan Brown and Michael Pitts go on a week-long bowhunting trip in Georgia during the rut; Pitts tries to find out if an EHD caused a foot injury on the giant 10 point that he is hunting.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Kansas Flyer Buck
waypointtv.us.description: On his third trip of the season to Kansas, Tyler Jordan finally connects on a big flyer buck with his Hoyt RX-10 in hand; everything comes together in a moment that bow hunters dream about.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Louisiana Monster Bucks- Hidden Jewel of Deer Hunting
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E26 Michael Pitts and the crew head out to Honeybrake Lodge in Louisiana for some big buck deer hunting action; Honeybrake is known as a top-rated spot for duck hunting.

waypointtv.us.title: Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation : Better Than We Found It
waypointtv.us.description: Bob Ziehmer, Senior Director of Conservation for Bass Pro Shops & Cabela's, addresses the care of natural resources for future generations; Ziehmer asserts it is the responsibility of citizens to leave resources in better condition for the future.

waypointtv.us.title: Winchester Life : Camp Longbeard
waypointtv.us.description: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings.

waypointtv.us.title: Winchester Life : Alaska Supreme
waypointtv.us.description: Highlighting the stories and people who have made the shooting sports and hunting lifestyle a part of their lives.

waypointtv.us.title: Winchester Life : Precision Rifle Perfected
waypointtv.us.description: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they'll put Winchester's new Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test.

waypointtv.us.title: Winchester Life : The Spies Tradition
waypointtv.us.description: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation : An American Icon
waypointtv.us.description: Building a new bison herd on the island of Sitkaladak, the indigenous Alutiiq community of Old Harbour takes ownership of their food security and subsistence way of life.

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation : Another World
waypointtv.us.description: In the remote Turkish mountains, host Dan Cabela looks at how regulated hunting of ibex has helped protect large areas for wildlife, and funds local conservation initiatives.

waypointtv.us.title: Wildbound by Forloh
waypointtv.us.description: New Zealand Andy and his son, Logan, visit the country of New Zealand; they explore vineyards, helicopter hunts and more.

waypointtv.us.title: Wildbound by Forloh
waypointtv.us.description: Wildbound -- Alaska Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of salmon fishing and hunting black-tailed deer.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Beginning in summer of 1990, the bodies of several women began turning up in and around the city of Vienna, Austria. From an extensive investigation by the Viennese police, it was determined that these murders were the work of one sadistic predator. Europe was dealing with a serial killer. With no experience with this kind of predator, Viennese police turned to the FBI. FBI profilers were able to identify a suspect in the murders. More ominously, they linked this same killer to murders committed in the United States.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On August 20, 1980, an unseen sniper murdered two young black men as they jogged with two white women in Salt Lake City, Utah. Police threw all their resources into finding a killer who left almost no clues behind. They met with FBI agents and detectives from around the country who had similar racially motivated sniper slayings. A month later, working off little more than a possible license plate number, police in Kentucky arrested Joseph Paul Franklin but the man escaped from custody.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: By April of 1995 in Washington, D.C., two officers had been shot and one had been murdered. Each had been sitting in their patrol cars when a man sneaked up and opened fire. The FBI was brought in to help catch the cop killer. Agents identified the man who was most likely the killer, but he was nowhere to be found. Months of surveillance operations around the country finally yielded a break; they found their suspect in Baltimore, MD.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Racial tensions in Buffalo in 1980 were at an all-time high. Six black males had been brutally murdered--two had their hearts cut out. The only thing connecting the victims was their ethnicity and the fact that each had been shot with .22 caliber bullets. Residents screamed for the police to stop this serial killer. With no suspects, local investigators turned to the FBI. Profilers were able to produce a psychological composite of the type of person the killer would most likely be. Their analysis paid off.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On February 3, 1990, a 14-year-old girl ran away from her mother's home and disappeared without a trace. Her mother hoped Pasadena, Texas police could find her before it was too late. Six months later, their worst fear was realized when a farmer discovered the young girl's remains in an Illinois barn. The FBI was called in to help. Agents tracked down a trucker who they believed was responsible for 50 more deaths. Investigators knew they had to stop this menace of the highways.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When a Delaware woman vanished in 1996, family and friends discovered her secret life. The appointments secretary to the Governor had carried on an illicit affair with a wealthy married man. Agents suspected that her powerful ex-lover was responsible, but they had little physical evidence to support their theory. Investigators never found the woman's body or the murder weapon. The FBI's only hope was to go undercover, and turn brother against brother.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 90s, Washington, D.C. police were losing the battle against street gangs who enforced their territories with lethal violence. The homicide rate in the nation's capital climbed to the highest in the country. Local police turned to the FBI for help, but agents soon found themselves in the direct line of fire. In the fall of 1994, a gang member walked into police headquarters, killed two FBI agents and one detective, then turned the gun on himself.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In June of 1992, masked bandits pulled off a daring mid-day bank robbery. It marked the beginning of a four-year crime wave that rocked Seattle. With each new robbery, the bandits perfected their craft, leaving behind no evidence and escaping with hundreds and thousands of dollars. As the robbers became increasingly violent, pressure mounted to end their reign. With few leads, the FBI forced their own luck. The effort put them face to face with an armed and desperate fugitive.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When police in a small Washington State community began looking into the disappearance of a 22-year-old woman, they had no way of knowing it would evolve into a nationwide hunt for a sexual sadist. Police knew the killer's identity, but he was a master of disguise. The FBI was called on to help. Agents discovered that several unsuspecting women across the northwest had fallen prey to his charms.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A stranger snatched an eight-year-old girl as she played in her Tucson, Arizona neighborhood, leaving behind an abandoned bicycle and a frantic mother. Hundreds of citizens and police officers fanned out across the region, hoping to find some trace of the young girl or her abductor. Within hours, a suspect emerged; a drifter who was out on parole for abducting and molesting children. He was nowhere to be found and time had run out for the innocent child.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On a chilly afternoon in 1989, Marine Captain Shirley Russell disappeared from Quantico, Virginia. Captain Russell was a dedicated officer; her friends and colleagues were certain she had not gone AWOL. FBI agents found her husband, a former Marine, was acting strangely, and a blood-like stain on the couple's floor disappeared before agents could examine it. There was no body, no witness and no weapon.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In February of 1996, New Jersey millionaire Frank Black flew to Florida to close a major business deal before retiring. He never came home. Authorities in New Jersey sensed foul play and brought in the FBI. Agents learned of a mystery woman in Florida who was to meet Black. Phone records showed a flood of calls to Black from his business rival just before the disappearance.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1997, FBI agents began investigating New York gas station mogul Gurmeet Dhinsa for gas pump rigging. They soon realized that Dhinsa was more than a crooked businessman, he enforced his mob-like operation with brutal violence, kidnapping and killing errant employees and any family members who questioned their deaths. FBI agents worked their way into Dhinsa's violent world.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 1980s, the decapitation of a young African-American male led the Miami-Dade police department and the FBI along a trail of murder. Investigators quickly discovered that the victim was a dissident member of a religious sect headed by a man calling himself Yahweh ben Yahweh, or God, Son of God. Although the FBI believed Yahweh ben Yahweh and his followers were responsible for many murders, they could find no direct evidence linking them to the crimes.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In November of 1994, when a Wells Fargo armored van disappeared from a Glendale, Arizona mall, local authorities and the FBI scrambled to recover it, and its cargo of nearly a million dollars. Six hours later, agents found the van, its driver shot dead inside and the money gone. It was a perfect hit by professionals who left no clue behind. Months passed before a solid lead developed. In January, a tip led agents to look into a former prison guard.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Beginning in California in 1995, a serial killer targeted vulnerable women. At first charming and generous, he quickly became violent. He was brutal with his kills and quick in his getaways. Traveling across the country, he struck in Mississippi, Louisiana and Florida. The FBI and local police needed to stop this cross-country killer before more women fell victim to his insatiable rage.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1987, a successful television producer was gunned down in his New York office. It looked like a professional hit. With no leads, the investigation stalled. Four years later and a continent away, a man told Los Angeles police he had been hired to murder two exotic dancers. Investigators linked the two crimes and uncovered a businessman willing to kill to protect his interests.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A 1981 armored car robbery near New York City left one guard dead and another critically wounded. Police stopped suspects nearby and another shoot-out ensued, claiming the lives of two officers. Local police and the FBI suspected a large group of domestic terrorists with a history of violent crime. They would try to ferret out these heavily armed criminals who moved in a shadowy underworld and were not afraid to kill authorities.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When a California man was found dismembered in 1990, police suspected a local burglar, but they couldn't find him. Six months later, he was caught robbing an Arizona bank and sentenced to life. But prison couldn't hold him for long, and within a year he escaped. The FBI would lead a multi-agency manhunt for a killer on a desperate run through the tourist regions of the west.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: At first it seemed like a tragic hunting accident when 18-year-old David Wilkey was shot to death in rural Virginia in 1983. A tenacious insurance investigator suspected foul play, but he had no direct evidence. Two years later a man contacted North Carolina FBI agents with a complex story of conspiracy and murder-for-hire: he claimed he had been hired to murder Wilkey's killer.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On a summer night in 1990, a body was discovered burning in a Minnesota alley. Weeks later, police finally identified the victim, a suspected drug courier from California. The FBI began working with local police and slowly uncovered a multi-state crime ring run by a deadly drug lord who used violence and intimidation to keep those around him silent. Agents needed to infiltrate and dismantle the crew before more people died.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Join Monty at Longmeadow for an indulgent, horticultural romp through the `Gardeners' World' archives and a joyous riot of colour as we celebrate some of our most beloved summer flowers. From Delphiniums to Clematis, Irises and Dahlias expert growers share their passion along with hints and tips. Carol Klein visits a garden in Worcestershire where she discovers picture perfect peonies.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty shows how to pot tomatoes on to the next stage of their growth. Adam Frost has ideas of transforming a part of his garden into a seating area using a few logs and plants.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: At Longmeadow, Monty adds a variety of herbs that thrive in shade to the herb garden and adds summer annuals to the cottage garden. Nick Bailey has taken a rare opportunity to design his town garden from scratch.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Join Adam in his garden for a seasonal catch-up. Toby Buckland gives timely tips on summer and autumn maintenance for borders, plus join singer-songwriter Billie Marten as she shares her passion for growing vegetables.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: At Longmeadow, Monty shows how to harvest and store potatoes. He also adds late summer colour to the cottage garden and prunes shrub roses. Carol Klein travels to Norfolk to meet Adrian Bloom, a member of a horticultural dynasty.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With the arrival of October, it is time to start thinking about getting some onions and garlic in the ground, and Monty Don shares his secrets on how to get a successful crop. Elsewhere, Carol Klein takes first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for a day out in Devon. They are on the hunt for some seasonal inspiration for their new garden and what better place to look than RHS Rosemoor.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty Don is asked to rescue two nightmare outside spaces. In Salisbury, newly engaged Glenn and Zoe want a brand new garden and most of all they are desperate to produce flowers for their wedding. Currently their steeply sloping garden is completely unusable.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty Don is asked to rescue two nightmare outside spaces. In Salisbury, newly engaged Glenn and Zoe want a brand new garden and most of all they are desperate to produce flowers for their wedding. Currently their steeply sloping garden is completely unusable.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: In Brighton determined duo Helen and Dax have their hands full with twins, one of whom has special needs. Meanwhile in High Wycombe, newly single Valerie is looking for a fresh lease of life.

700407.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don returns to Japan during the fiery blaze of autumn. He visits the three great gardens of Japan to learn how they protect the garden from the coming winter and learns how the Japanese are weaving nature into their concrete urban jungle.

700407.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don returns to Japan during the fiery blaze of autumn. He visits the three great gardens of Japan to learn how they protect the garden from the coming winter and learns how the Japanese are weaving nature into their concrete urban jungle.

700407.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
700407.description: Starting his journey at the sole surviving garden of the 1600s, Levens Hall in Cumbria, Monty sets out to investigate what the gardens of this age would have looked like and what influenced and inspired their creation.

700407.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
700407.description: Monty bases himself at Rousham House in Oxfordshire, designed by one of the first practitioners of the landscape movement, William Kent. It has survived almost unchanged since its completion in 1741.

700407.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
700407.description: Monty Don explores the extraordinary transformations that occurred throughout the 19th century. As a result of an expanding empire, scientific and technological innovation and social change, British gardens became more exotic, more colourful and more widely accessible than ever before.

700407.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
700407.description: Monty Don concludes his journey through Britain's gardening heritage by looking at how the nation's gardens have evolved over the last hundred years. He looks at the profound effect that two world wars had on the attitude to gardens and gardening.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog is back hunting in the big city of Denver, but chasing fugitives on the mainland is more dangerous than ever. So Dog decides that the crew should get pepper-ball guns, which have much better range than pepper spray.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog decides to help two of his bondsmen buddies, Dave "Red" Widhelm and "Downtown" Bobby Brown. First up is Red, who has a client named Alvin who failed to appear on a $20,000 bond with charges of drug possession and distribution pending.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog leads the team on another adrenaline-filled chase in Denver. The fugitive, Robert, has a habit of address-hopping that makes him a difficult target, but Dog refuses to give up and finally tracks Robert down in his latest hideaway.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: The team is still in Colorado, and today Dog starts his day by to giving his kids and crew a sample of their western heritage by taking them horseback riding. This hunt takes Dog back to his old stomping grounds in Denver.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog and Beth are finally getting married! They've been together for more than ten years but Dog is determined, as he puts it, to "marry his common law wife the Christian way." There are big nuptials planned on the Big Island.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog, Beth and the posse are off to the Big Island for their wedding. They hope to relax for a few days and take care of final details but it turns out Leland has a fugitive he needs to capture.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: When the team hunts for Steven, a fugitive with a history of domestic abuse, they seek help from his girlfriend, who's been a victim of his abuse. Meanwhile, Beth trains for a 5K race to help raise awareness about domestic abuse.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog is going to be the keynote speaker at the annual Profession Bail Agents convention in Las Vegas, but before he leaves he's got to clear two cases from his docket--Heidi and Stephanie. Heidi is a check forger who's failed to make a court appearance.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Tim's got a big problem on his hands. One of his clients, Owen, has failed to appear in court. He's on bond for serious drug charges and now Tim could lose $30,000 if he doesn't catch Owen.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: It's been raining for days and the team is going a little stir crazy. Dog however has the cure--a good hunt. Maui has failed to appear on a drug charge and the team has just one lead.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: As Dog likes to say, "it's not the years it's the miles," and this goes for both men and machines. Those long hunts and the rides to jail take a toll not only on Dog but also on his vehicles.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog has two fugitives to catch, and he gets help from the unlikeliest sources--the fugitives' mothers. First, Ginger's mother wants to revoke her daughter's bond because 18-year-old Ginger is selling drugs and running wild.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Colorado bondsman Bobby Brown's got trouble and his name is Jackson. Weighing in at over 240lbs and standing six foot tall this bad boy has skipped out on a $10,000 bond.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: With twelve kids of his own Dog knows how hard it is to keep children on the straight and narrow, especially during their turbulent teens.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: A one-hour special that looks back at 2006, one of Dog's most tumultuous years, which has included the passing of Beth's father, Dog and Beth's wedding, the tragic death of Dog's daughter Barbara, and the sudden arrest of Dog, Tim, and Leland.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog usually takes his job personally, but this time a case really hits home. First, he and Beth receive a special gift--a painting of Dog's recently deceased daughter, Barbara Katy.
