400000088.description: Dog finds himself fighting two enemies--the law and his inner demons. He continues his legal battle to fight extradition to Mexico in connection with his 2003 capture of fugitive rapist Andrew Luster. His other struggle is private.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog shows his love of justice and children in this poignant episode. He begins by giving encouragement to a group of handicapped children and making them honorary members of his posse.

673498.title: Face of a Fugitive
673498.description: While being escorted to jail, bank robber Jim Larson (Fred MacMurray) manages to get the upper hand on his captor and escape. Jim is surprised to see his brother appear on the scene, ready to aid his sibling. As they make their getaway, his brother and the pursuing lawman shoot each other, leaving the stunned Jim alone and on the run. Assuming a different identity, Jim travels to a mining town and befriends the local sheriff (Lin McCarthy), hoping to start over and find redemption.

673498.title: 3:10 to Yuma

Accompanied only by the town drunk, Alex Potter (Henry Jones), Dan battles Wade's henchman (Richard Jaeckel), the murder victim's revenge-minded brother, and the temptation of the large bribe Wade offers in exchange for his freedom.

673498.title: The Big Gundown
673498.description: Lawman John Corbett (Lee Van Cleef) searches the U.S.-Mexico border for a Mexican peasant (Tomas Milian) accused of raping and killing a 12-year-old girl.

673498.description: A cowboy discards his chaps and saddle for a suit and tie when he travels to the big city to investigate a produce racket that has been ruining his father's lettuce shipments.

673498.description: After the Civil War, a spy for the Confederacy absconds to Arizona to start a new life but gets reluctantly pulled into a stagecoach gold robbery.

673498.title: Wyoming Renegades
673498.description: An ex-convict (Phil Carey) and his girlfriend (Martha Hyer) cannot start over until they stop Butch Cassidy's (Gene Evans) gang.

673498.title: The Texican
673498.description: Deputy Jess Carlin (Audie Murphy) leaves his Texas hometown in disgrace, framed by corrupt saloon owner Luke Starr (Broderick Crawford) for a crime he didn't commit. When his brother, muckraking newspaper editor Roy Carlin (Víctor Vilanova), is murdered after printing an exposé of Starr's crooked deals, Carlin returns home from the Mexican border town where he's been holed up and enlists his brother's fiancée (Luz Márquez) and saloon dancer Kit O'Neal (Diana Lorys) to bring Starr down.

673498.title: Stage to Tucson
673498.description: Trouble-shooters (Rod Cameron, Wayne Morris) track Arizona stagecoaches hijacked for sale to the Confederacy.

673498.title: The Gun That Won the West
673498.description: Superior Springfield rifles help scouts (Dennis Morgan, Richard Denning) and the cavalry get forts built in Wyoming.

673500.title: The Guilt of Janet Ames
673500.description: War widow Janet Ames (Rosalind Russell) is struck by a car, and later her doctors suspect she may have been attempting suicide. A note in her pocket lists five men whom her husband died saving in battle, and they are contacted to help Janet's recovery. The first man on the list, jaded reporter Smitty Cobb (Melvyn Douglas), is offended when Janet says she hopes to prove her husband died in vain to save five worthless men, and offers to "introduce" Janet to each of the men through hypnotism.

673500.title: What a Woman!
673500.description: An author (Willard Parker) and a literary agent (Rosalind Russell) become involved after selling film rights to his racy book.

673500.title: The Trouble with Angels
673500.description: A Reverend Mother faces an uphill battle to reform a pair of young, hard-to-reach troublemakers who’ve been wreaking havoc on her convent school.

673500.title: Middle of the Night
673500.description: A May-December romance blooms between a 53-year old widowed clothing manufacturer and an employee 30 years his junior, much to his family’s chagrin.

673500.title: The Jolson Story
673500.description: At the turn of the 20th century, young Asa Yoelson (Scotty Beckett) decides to go against the wishes of his cantor father (Ludwig Donath) and pursue a career in show business. Gradually working his way up through the vaudeville ranks, Asa -- now calling himself Al Jolson (Larry Parks) -- joins a blackface minstrel troupe and soon builds a reputation as a consummate performer. But as his career grows in size, so does his ego, resulting in battles in business as well as in his personal life.

673500.title: Twentieth Century
673500.description: When down-on-his-luck Broadway impresario Oscar Jaffe (John Barrymore) meets his discovery and former flame, Lily Garland (Carole Lombard), on the glamorous 20th Century Limited train between Chicago and New York, he uses every scheme at his disposal to win the movie star back both professionally and romantically. However, Lily, along with her new beau, George (Ralph Forbes), and Jaffe's rival producer, Max Jacobs (Charles Levison), who hired Lily to star in his latest play, have other plans.

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: History's Deadliest With Ving Rhames - Islands

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: History's Deadliest With Ving Rhames - Tyrants
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: From Caligula and Ivan the Terrible to Mao Zedong and Saddam Hussein, a look at history's most brutal tyrants and the devastating impact of their rule. (Special Interest)

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: James Brown: Say It Loud - The Most Powerful Black Man In America
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: Aligning with the civil rights movement, James Brown becomes a cultural icon, inspiring pride and wielding political influence. (Special Interest)

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Secrets Of Penthouse - The Madman

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Secrets Of Penthouse - The Father

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Big Short

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Empty Beach
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Bryan Brown stars as private investigator Cliff Hardy, who is hired to find a missing woman but uncovers corruption, lies and hidden dangers beneath Sydney's affluent surface.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Darkside
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Director Warwick Thornton assembles a collection of poignant, sad, funny, and absurd true ghost stories from across Australia with some of Australia's most iconic actors as the storytellers.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Satellite Boy
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Ten-year-old Pete lives with his grandfather in an old outdoor cinema in the desert. When the drive-in is threatened with demolition, Pete sets off on an epic journey in the hopes of saving his home.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Story Of A Love Affair
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Michelangelo Antonioni's acclaimed breakthrough follows a wealthy woman and her former lover whose rekindled romance draws them into a destructive world of jealousy and betrayal.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: True Grit
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Fourteen-year-old Mattie Ross is determined to avenge her father's blood by capturing Tom Chaney, the man who shot and killed him for two pieces of gold.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Black Dahlia
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Josh Hartnett, Aaron Eckhart and Scarlett Johansson star in Brian De Palma's noir thriller inspired by Hollywood's most infamous unsolved murder and the obsession it creates.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Killing Of A Sacred Deer
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Steven, a heart surgeon, is forced to make an unthinkable sacrifice after his life starts to fall apart, when the behaviour of a teenage boy he has taken under his wing turns sinister. (Colin Farrell).

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Mona Lisa
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Bob Hoskins delivers an Oscar-nominated performance as an ex-con hired to chauffeur a high-class escort, only to become entangled in London's dangerous criminal underworld.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Walkabout To Hollywood
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: This film concerns David Gulpilil's work to bridge the gap between his life as an Indigenous Australian and as a film and TV actor.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Babette's Feast
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: During the late 19th century, a strict religious community in a Danish village takes in a French refugee as a family cook to the late pastor's daughters. 1988 Oscar for Best Foreign Language Film.
